propositions: review_interrupts metric is published without reason field, preventing CloudWatch alarms from distinguishing bound-exceeded (bot busy, drain check working) from signal-unavailable (probe broken, deploys blind)

splitting review_interrupts into separate reason-keyed metrics requires changes to observability.sh section 4e to emit review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable alongside unchanged rolled-up total

two new CloudWatch alarms must replace the single review_interrupts alarm in monitoring_autodeploy.tf, each carrying only its own reason's remediation and keeping signal-unavailable's prompt evaluation (1 datapoint)
split must be proven by automated test driving real observability.sh over synthetic journal, including the case where all firings are bound-exceeded to verify signal-unavailable remains 0
Terraform apply in infra/terraform is required to activate the alarm changes; metric publication begins on merge but actual alarming behavior does not change until apply completes
